memoryBox.heroImageAlt: Warm family gathering — memories worth preserving
memoryBox.heroSupport: Ship us the shoebox. We digitize your photos, tapes, and film — then they appear automatically in your Photos page when ready.
memoryBox.howLead: One flat price. One box. When digitizing is done, your files land in Photos automatically — honest timelines, no rush job.
memoryBox.pricingNote: Includes the box, return guidance, and digitizing. Completed files appear automatically in your Photos page — typically about 5–8 weeks after we receive your filled box (your empty box arrives in about 2 weeks).
memoryBox.pricingTitle: Everything in the box, digitized with care
memoryBox.promoBody: We’ll digitize them for you — then they appear automatically in Photos.
memoryBox.promoTitle: Have boxes of old photos or tapes?
memoryBox.step1Body: Expect your Family Memory Box within about 2 weeks of ordering.
memoryBox.step2Body: Pack photos, tapes, and reels. After we receive your box, digitizing takes about 5–8 weeks.
memoryBox.step2Title: You fill it & ship it back
memoryBox.step3Body: When processing is complete, your digitized media shows up automatically on your Photos page — no manual upload.

people.facePrivacyNote: Face recognition stays private to your account — it helps you name the people in your photos. It only runs on photos that are ready, and never shares face data with others.
